name: plan_settle
doc: A plan system (design/planner.md): lays out a settlement on a plan map from a scenario config and a seed. It sets the ground (natural heights, then levelled pads, graded streets, eased edges), lays streets by scenario (least-cost roads from the entrances to a node, back lanes on contours, alleys, rings, a keep's switchbacks, a river's quay and bridge), packs plots from the config's lots along their streets (turned by sixths to face them), zones and tiers them, places mounts for fixtures and decorations, and builds a navigation mesh it checks: every plot reached from every entrance, and every store, workshop, inn, and civic plot by cart.
